items.snippet: 김종철 경찰청 차장(56·간부후보 45기·사진)이 6일 신임 경찰청장 후보자로 임명 제청됐다. 경찰청장은 12·3 비상계엄 이후 약 23개월간 직무대행 체제였다. 국가경찰위원회는 이날 오후 서울 서대문구에서 회의를 열고 김 차장에 대한 경찰청장 임명 제청 동의안을 의결했다. 윤호중 행정안전부 장관은 이어 정부서울청사 브리핑에서 김 차장을 이재명 대통령에게 임명 제청했다고 밝혔다. 윤 장관은 “형사사법 체계 개편과 경찰 개혁이라는 시대적 과제 수행을 위한 거시적 안목도 겸비하고 있다”고 제청 배경을 설명했다. 김 차장은 회의에 앞서 취재진과 만나 “엄중한 시기에 지명돼 막중한 책임감을 느낀다”고 했다. 회의 뒤 최우선 과제를 묻자 “이상 동기 범죄나 관계성 범죄로부터 국민이 피해를 당하는 일이 없도록 시스템과 현장 매뉴얼을 정비하는 게 급선무”...

items.title: 정무수석에 ‘원조 친노’ 최인호… 당내 갈등 해소 의지
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 6일 신임 대통령정무수석비서관으로 내정한 최인호 전 주택도시보증공사(HUG) 사장(60)은 ‘원조 친노(친노무현)계’로 부산에서 재선 국회의원을 지냈다. 최 신임 수석에게 친명(친이재명)계와 친노·친문(친문재인)을 잇는 역할을 맡기며 당내 갈등 해소에 나선 것으로 풀이된다. 최 수석은 경남 창녕 출신으로 부산대 정치외교학과를 졸업했다. 노무현 전 대통령이 국회의원으로 재직할 당시 비서관을 지냈고, 노무현 정부에선 대통령홍보수석비서관실 국내언론비서관으로 일했다. 이후 20, 21대 총선에서 부산 사하갑에서 당선돼 재선 의원을 지냈다. 2022년 민주당 대선 후보 경선 당시 이낙연 후보를 도왔지만 이후에는 이 대통령과 정치적 행보를 함께해 왔다. 22대 총선에선 같은 지역구에서 낙선한 뒤 올해 1월 HUG 사장으로 임명됐다. 청와...

items.title: ‘조작기소 특검’ 파견검사 20명에 수사권… “구법 적용 위헌 소지”
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 주도로 6일 ‘조작수사·조작기소 진상규명 특검법’(조작기소 특검법)이 국회 본회의을 통과하면서 윤석열 정부 시절 검찰, 국가정보원 등이 처리한 주요 사건의 수사·기소 과정이 검증대에 올랐다. 개정 형사소송법이 시행되면서 검사의 직접 수사권은 폐지됐지만, 이번 특검에 파견되는 공소청 검사 최대 20명은 직접 수사할 수 있다. 이재명 대통령이 자신과 관련된 사건의 수사·기소 과정을 들여다볼 특검을 임명하는 방식과 수사 협조자의 형을 감경하거나 면제하는 조항을 두고도 논란이 일고 있다.● 공소청 검사, 특검 파견되면 직접수사공소청 검사는 이번 특검에 파견되면 직접 수사하거나 수사를 지휘할 수 있다. 지난달 2일부터 검사의 직접수사권은 원칙적으로 폐지됐지만, 특검법 부칙이 파견검사 등의 수사권과 지휘권에는 종전 형사소송법을 적용하도록 했...

items.title: 여권서도 특검법 우려… 前법무 정성호 “조작 규명 쉽지 않아”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령 사건 등을 겨냥한 ‘조작기소 특검법’이 6일 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 본회의를 통과한 가운데, 여권에서도 법안의 위헌 소지와 법리적 모순을 지적하는 목소리가 잇따랐다. 이재명 정부 초대 법무부 장관을 지낸 민주당 정성호 의원은 이날 특검 수사로 조작기소를 밝혀낼 수 있는지에 대해 “쉽지는 않다고 본다”며 “좀 더 숙의 과정이 필요하지 않았나”라고 말했다. 그는 장관 시절 관련 사건의 진상조사에서 입증에 어려움을 겪었던 점을 언급하며 “무리한 수사가 있었던 것은 확실한데 과연 그걸 갖고 조작이라고 할 수가 있느냐, 바로 연결 지을 수 있느냐는 게 쉽지 않았던 것”이라고 덧붙였다. 곽상언 의원은 통화에서 “법안이 발의되고 나면 최소한 국회 전문위원들이 지적한 것은 해소해야 하는 것 아니냐”고 했다. 곽 의원은 “특검법안의 수사대상...

items.title: 韓-동티모르 정상 “지식재산-기후변화 등 협력”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 6일 조제 하무스오르타 동티모르 대통령과 정상회담을 갖고 “동티모르가 새로운 도약을 이뤄가는 여정에서도 대한민국은 언제나 좋은 친구이자 든든한 동반자가 될 것”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 이날 오전 청와대에서 정상회담을 마친 뒤 공동 언론발표에서 “양국은 어두운 역사를 극복하고 독립을 이뤄냈고, 어려움 속에서도 민주주의를 지켜왔다는 점에서 서로 많이 닮아 있다”며 이같이 말했다. 동티모르 정상이 양자 회담을 위해 공식 방한한 건 2002년 양국이 수교한 후 처음이다. 두 정상은 지식재산·기후변화 협력과 함께 동티모르 경제·사회 발전을 지원하기 위한 개발 협력을 강화하기로 했다. 인도네시아가 동티모르를 식민 지배하던 시절 독립운동을 했던 하무스오르타 대통령은 1996년 비폭력 저항운동에 앞장선 공로로 노벨 평화상을 받았다. 김대중...

items.title: 신천지 조사 결과 본 친명 “심각한 상황”… 친청은 “3자 비밀 연합 근거 없어” 반박
items.snippet: 더불어민주당이 6일 ‘신천지 신도 집단 당원 가입 의혹’에 대한 당내 조사 결과를 의원 등에게 개별 열람 방식으로 공개했다. 자료를 확인한 친명(친이재명)계 의원들은 “전남광주와 전북 등에서 신천지 신도 가입이 심각한 상황이었다”며 집단 가입 정황을 지적했지만 친청(친정청래)계는 “반명(반이재명)·분열주의·신천지 3자 비밀 연합의 근거는 전혀 없었다”며 반발했다. 민주당은 이날부터 일주일 동안 당 소속 의원과 원외지역위원장을 대상으로 신천지 의혹에 대한 자체 조사 결과를 공개하기로 했다. 자료에는 지역별로 일반 당원 1만 명과 권리당원 8000명 규모의 신천지 신도 당원 가입 정황이 들어갔지만, 구체적인 입당 시기와 명단은 담겨 있지 않은 것으로 전해졌다. 친명계 조계원 의원은 자료 열람 후 기자들과 만나 “비공개 개별 열람은 잘한 선택”이라...

items.title: 오세훈, 한동훈 복당론에 “당내 대다수 공감해야”
items.snippet: 국민의힘 중진 의원 일부가 무소속 한동훈 의원의 복당을 주장하고 나선 가운데 오세훈 서울시장이 6일 “당내 대다수 구성원의 공감대 형성이 전제돼야 한다”며 신중론을 펼쳤다. 오 시장은 이날 국회에서 열린 국민의힘-서울시 예산정책협의회를 마친 후 기자들과 만나 한 의원 복당에 대해 “분위기가 성숙하는 것이 정말 중요하고, 그런 뜻에서 지난번에 ‘신중해야 된다’ ‘유리그릇 다루듯이 해야 될 문제’라고 말씀드린 바가 있다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 이어 “갈등과 분열이 최소화될 수 있는 전제조건이 무엇인지 논의가 필요하다”고 강조했다. 섣부르게 복당 문제가 본격적으로 논의될 경우 당내 갈등이 증폭될 수 있다는 점을 지적한 것. 이날 예산정책협의회에는 장동혁 대표도 참석했다. 장 대표와 오 시장 모두 당과 서울시 간의 소통 확대를 강조했다. 장 대표는 “국...

items.title: 李대통령 직무평가 긍정 41%-부정 50%
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령의 국정에 대한 긍정평가는 41%, 부정평가는 50%로 집계됐다. 한국갤럽이 3∼5일 전국 만 18세 이상 1001명을 대상으로 실시해 6일 발표한 여론조사(전화면접 방식, 95% 신뢰수준에 표본오차 ±3.1%포인트, 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조)에 따르면 이 대통령에 대한 직무수행 평가는 ‘잘하고 있다’는 응답이 41%, ‘잘못하고 있다’는 답변이 50%였다. 직전 조사(10월 다섯째 주)에서는 긍정 평가 39%, 부정 평가 49%로 각각 조사됐다. 긍정 평가 이유는 ‘외교’(18%), ‘경제·민생’(15%), ‘소통’(10%) 등의 순이었다. 부정 평가 이유로는 ‘부동산 정책’(19%), ‘경제·민생’(13%) 등이 꼽혔다. 한국갤럽은 “부동산 문제가 7월 넷째 주부터 계속해서 부정 평가 이유 최상위”...

items.snippet: 롯데케미칼이 올해 3분기 적자 폭을 늘렸다. 시장 예상보다 부진의 골이 깊었다.롯데케미칼은 3분기 연결 기준 잠정 실적으로 매출액 5조3천951억 원, 영업손실 2천814억 원을 거뒀다고 6일 공시했다.전년 동기 대비 매출액은 12.7% 늘었지만 적자 폭은 늘렸다.3분기는 시장 예상을 하회하는 손익을 기록했다. 다만 매출액은 시장 기대치를 웃돌았다.연합인포맥스가 최근 두 달 내 국내 증권사 3곳이 제출한 실적 전망치를 집계한 결과, 롯데케미칼은 올해 3분기 연결 기준 매출액 5조695억 원, 영업손실 2천21억 원을 거둘 것으로

items.title: Iran delivers secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes gas pipeline deal
items.snippet: Iran’s Security Council chief, Mohsen Rezaei, went to Moscow to deliver a personal message from Ayatollah Khamenei and discuss building a pipeline to import Russian gas.

items.title: Meghan Markle's father arrested and charged with possessing child sexual abuse material
items.snippet: Thomas Markle, the father of Prince Harry's wife, Meghan, was arrested Friday morning by federal agents in Florida on a federal criminal complaint alleging he kept child sexual abuse material, including sexually explicit photographs of himself with prepubescent girls, said the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Central District of California.

items.title: 李, 본인사건 수사 특검 ‘셀프 임명’ 할 수 있다
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 주도로 6일 국회 본회의를 통과한 ‘조작기소 특검법’에는 위헌·위법 소지가 있는 독소 조항이 여럿 담겨 논란이 일고 있다. 이번 특검법 수사 대상에는 대장동 개발 비리, 쌍방울 불법 대북 송금 사건 등 이재명 대통령이 기소돼 재판이 중단된 사건 8건이 포함돼 있고, 특검은 과거 검찰이 이 사건들을 수사하는 과정에서 위법이 있었는지 수사하게 된다. 법조계에선 “형사 사법 제도의 사유화” “대통령을 위해 법 질서를 무너뜨리겠다는 것”이라는 비판이 나왔다.

items.title: 2년 공석이던 경찰청장에 김종철 직무대행
items.snippet: 이재명 정부 첫 경찰청장 후보자로 청장 직무대행을 맡아 온 김종철(56) 경찰청 차장이 6일 임명 제청됐다. 경찰청장은 조지호 전 청장이 12·3 비상계엄에 가담한 혐의로 2024년 12월 직무가 정지된 이후 2년 가까이 공석이었다. 신임 국세청장 후보자로는 안덕수(55) 서울지방국세청장이 지명됐다.

items.title: Turkey to push for 'electrification' drive at COP31 as climate threats mount
items.snippet: COP31 host Turkey is set to push for a "electrification" drive to help meet global elergy demand as the UN climate conference kicks off in Antalya on Monday. The annual summit takes place this year under the shadow of a cost-of-living crisis fuelled by the war in the Middle East.

items.title: 아무리 외롭다고 집착하나… 6070 스토킹범 늘고 있다
items.snippet: 지난 5일 서울 은평구에서 옛 연인을 살해한 60대 남성 길모씨는 최근 이웃들에게 외로움을 자주 호소했다고 주민들이 6일 전했다. 길씨는 약 6개월 전 피해자와 헤어진 뒤로 이웃에게 부쩍 말을 걸고 먹을 것을 나눠주기도 했다고 한다. 이웃들은 “길씨가 평소 조용한 편이었는데 연인과 헤어진 뒤로 말 동무를 찾는 것 같았다”고 했다. 범죄 전문가들은 이런 주변 진술을 종합할 때 노년기 사회적 고립이 연인에 대한 집착으로 이어져 강력 범죄를 낳았을 가능성을 분석할 필요가 있다고 말한다.

items.title: 공소청, 강호동 농협중앙회장 구속영장 기각
items.snippet: 서울중앙지방공소청이 6일 경찰이 신청했던 강호동 농협중앙회장에 대한 구속영장을 기각했다.

items.title: “월세 부담 덜고 생활비 아끼고” 동거커플 31% 증가
items.snippet: 서울 마포구에 사는 나모(30)씨는 6년 전 취업에 성공했다. 나씨는 회사에 다니며 월급을 받기 시작했지만 월세와 생활비를 내고 나면 통장에 남는 돈은 얼마 되지 않았다고 한다. 나씨는 내 집 마련은커녕 결혼 자금을 모으기도 막막했다. 비슷한 시기에 취업한 여자 친구도 같은 고민을 하고 있었다.

items.title: 입동 하루 앞두고 기온 뚝
items.snippet: 6일 서울 종로구 경복궁에서 관광객들이 두꺼운 외투에 목도리를 한 차림으로 길을 걷고 있다. 절기상 입동(立冬)인 7일에는 찬 북서풍의 영향으로 전국의 기온이 크게 떨어질 전망이다. 7일 전국 최저기온은 영하 6도에서 영상 5도로 예상된다. 서울도 7일 최저기온이 영하 1도까지 내려가, 일부 지역에는 살얼음이 얼 수 있다. 입동에 서울 최저기온이 5도 밑으로 내려간 건 최근 10년간 세 차례에 불과했다. 작년 입동에는 최저 8.3도, 최고 19.9도로 포근했다.

items.title: 12월 법관회의, 이달 30일로 앞당겨… 대법원장 국조·탄핵 대응 방안 논의
items.snippet: 판사 회의체인 전국법관대표회의가 오는 30일 정기회의를 연다. 원래 다음 달 7일 열 예정이던 회의를 앞당긴 것이다. 여권이 조희대 대법원장에 대한 국회 국정조사 등 사법부 압박에 나서자, 판사들이 대응 방안을 논의하자고 요구한 데 따른 것이다. 법관대표회의는 6일 “정기회의를 앞당기는 방안에 대한 투표를 진행한 결과 2026년 하반기 정기회의 개최일을 이달 30일로 변경하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 투표는 지난 4일 진행됐다.

items.title: 대구 달성군 출생아 수, 전국 82개 군 중에서 10년 연속 1위
items.snippet: 지난해 대구 달성군에서 태어난 아이는 1508명으로 전국 82개 군(郡) 가운데 가장 많았다. 2016년부터 10년 연속 1위다. 올해 1~9월 출생아도 1265명으로 지난해 같은 기간(1132명)보다 133명(11.7%) 늘었다. 지난해 합계출산율(여성 1명이 평생 낳을 것으로 예상되는 평균 출생아 수)은 1.02명으로 전국 평균(0.8명)을 웃돌았다. 달성군은 일자리, 주거, 보육 삼박자를 갖춘 곳이다. 달성군 현풍읍과 유가읍에는 첨단산업도시 대구테크노폴리스가 조성됐다. HD현대로보틱스 등 기업과 대구경북과학기술원(DGIST)이 들어서 있다. 근처에는 대구국가산업단지도 있다. 일자리가 생기고 아파트 단지가 들어서면서 젊은 부부가 모여들었다. 달성군 인구는 1995년 대구시 편입 당시 11만3000명에서 지난해 26만3000명으로 두 배 넘...

items.title: 선생님 부담 줄여주려다 ‘0세 반’이 줄어들고 있다
items.snippet: 정부가 어린이집 0세반 교사 1명당 아동 수를 3명에서 2명으로 줄이는 정책을 추진 중인 가운데, 이를 따르면 한 반당 보육료 수입이 매달 60만원가량 줄어드는 것으로 나타났다. 수요 증가에도 운영할수록 손해가 예상되는 구조 탓에 원장들이 0세반을 기피하는 현상까지 나타나고 있다.

items.title: “결혼 6년 만에 낳은 아이, 최고의 피로회복제”
items.snippet: “집돌이·집순이였던 저희 부부는 두 딸이 태어난 뒤 대구 명소를 찾아 산책하는 게 취미가 됐습니다. 일이 바빠 두 딸 모두 돌잔치를 못 해줬는데, 오늘이 우리 가족 최고의 돌잔치 날이네요.”(‘31초 우리가족 행복담기 영상제’ 대상 김태형씨)

items.title: 엄우종 세계은행 부총재
items.snippet: 세계은행그룹(WBG)이 신설한 독립책임성기구 부총재에 엄우종 전 아시아개발은행(ADB) 사무총장이 선임됐다고 6일 재정경제부가 밝혔다. 그는 앞으로 세계은행 사업 관련 분쟁해결, 규정 준수 검토 및 자문 기능을 총괄하게 된다. 한국인이 세계은행그룹 부총재에 오른 것은 2024년 7월 김상부 디지털·인공지능 부총재에 이어 두 번째다.

items.title: 백현주한복연구소, 동티모르 대통령에 한복 선물
items.snippet: 백현주(오른쪽) 백현주한복연구소 대표가 지난 15일 서울 신라호텔에서 한국을 공식 방문한 조제 하무스 오르타 동티모르 대통령에게 전통 한복을 선물했다. 연구소는 1996년 노벨평화상 수상자인 오르타 대통령에게 한복을 선물하며 우리 민족의 아름다운 복식 문화와 전통의 가치를 전했다고 밝혔다. /백현주한복연구소

items.title: 눈도 안 마주치던 다문화 아이들… 함께 축구공 차니 어느새 ‘한 팀’
items.snippet: “처음에는 러시아와 우크라이나 출신 아이들끼리 서로 패스조차 하지 않았어요. 그런데 넉 달 동안 함께 뛰고 땀 흘리다 보니 어느새 한 팀이 되더라고요.”

[부음] 김시대 별세 외

items.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
items.snippet: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.

items.title: ‘Clock is ticking’: European TV channels targeted in wave of hoax bomb threats
items.snippet: Bomb threats warning “the clock ⁠is ticking” were sent to TV stations across Europe on Friday, prompting evacuations and programming to be suspended. Warnings were sent to Irish broadcaster RTE, Britain’s Sky, Bulgarian private station Nova TV and others, the companies said. No bombs were found at any affected site. RTE programmes were replaced by music and a pre-recorded ‌message, some for as long as three hours. Th...

items.title: Judge blocks construction of Trump's massive arch after federal agency approval
items.snippet: The Trump administration had hoped the construction of the 250-foot arch could begin as early as this week.

items.title: “응애, 이번 생은 인도 농부래”… 인생 뽑기에 빠지다
items.snippet: 태어난 곳은 부르키나파소의 농촌 마을. 가난한 집안에서 자라 학교 대신 농장에서 일했다. 끼니를 거르는 날이 잦았고, 열다섯에 결혼해 두 아이를 낳았다. 그러나 남편의 폭력에 시달리다 이혼했다. 이후 이미 아내가 있는 남자와 재혼해 셋째 아이를 낳았다. 마흔둘에는 이웃 나라 코트디부아르로 이주했고, 손주 다섯 명을 봤다. 생의 마지막까지 농장 일꾼으로 일하다 말라리아로 세상을 떠났다. 향년 57세.

items.title: 실록 지킨 ‘이안길’, 단풍 내린 ‘소망이루길’… 비경 내장한 산으로
items.snippet: 전체 인구 10만531명(2026년 9월 기준)의 인구 감소 지역에 속한 소도시가 매년 단풍 절정 시기 즈음인 10월 말, 11월 초만 되면 수십 만명의 관광객으로 들썩인다. 전남광주통합특별시 장성군, 전북 순창군과 함께 내장산국립공원을 품고 있는 전북 정읍시 얘기다. 정읍시에 따르면 올해 내장산 단풍 절정 시기는 7~8일 무렵으로, 기상 이변이 없는 한 중순까지 만추의 운치를 만끽할 수 있을 것으로 예상하고 있다. 벌써 입동(立冬·11월 7일)이라고 포기 마시라. 단풍 막차에 올라탈 가을의 최전선, 내장산이 있으니.

items.title: 처마 밑까지 쌓인 눈에 대한 기억
인간의 속도, 우주의 시간
items.snippet: 보이저 1호는 탐사선 가운데 지구로부터 가장 멀리 떨어져 있습니다. 이 보이저 1호가 오는 18일 새로운 역사를 씁니다. 1977년 발사된 지 49년 만에 지구에서 1광일(light-day·빛이 하루 동안 가는 거리) 떨어진 곳에 도달한다고 합니다. 1광일은 약 259억206만㎞입니다. 지구~태양 사이의 약 173배에 이르는 거리입니다.

items.title: 감옥 갈 사람 2명 중 1명은 사회로 나온다
items.snippet: 지난달 13일 오후 인천 남동구의 한 상가 푸드코트에서 식사를 하던 시민 100여 명은 순식간에 지옥을 경험했다. 양손에 흉기를 묶은 최충락(59)이 식사 중이던 이들을 무차별적으로 공격했기 때문이다. 8명이 다쳤고, 중태에 빠진 한 여성은 아직 깨어나지 못하고 있는 것으로 전해졌다.

items.title: 대기업 다니던 50대 김 부장, 이제 9급 공무원입니다
items.snippet: “연금이 큰 이유였죠.” 9급 공무원 시험에 합격해 다음 주 경북도청으로 출근 예정인 김씨는 1976년생이다. 올해 쉰 살, 중소기업에 다니며 외벌이로 두 자녀를 키우던 김씨가 올해 초 ‘공시생’으로 변신하게 된 건 고용 환경 및 공무원 연금 등의 향후 안정성 때문이었다. 그는 “노안까지 온 나이에 이게 무슨 고생인가 싶었지만, 정년 연장 논의도 있고, 갈아타려면 지금이 마지막 타이밍이라고 생각했다”며 “체력 부담이 있으니 한 번에 끝내려고 바짝 집중했다”고 했다. 퇴근 후 매일 새벽 2~3시까지 집에서 인터넷 강의를 들으며 독학했다. 그렇게 도전에 나선 50대, 지난 9월 발표된 경북도 지방공무원 전체 합격자 중 23명이었다.

items.title: 멈춤 체험 [고혜련의 삶이 있는 풍경] (28)
items.snippet: 방향을 잃고 정신없이 휩쓸리는 삶의 속도에서 비켜나 느림과 정적의 시간이 간절해질 때가 있다. 그때 은밀히 품어주는 곳이 있다. 가끔 그곳으로 간다. ‘템플스테이’ 하는 산속 사찰이다. 특정 종교인만 가는 곳이 아니다. 과도한 초(超)연결시대, 번잡한 세상사를 벗어나 홀로 자신의 꾸밈없는 본색과 마주하고픈 이들에게 살아갈 힘을 재충전해 주는 ‘피난처’ 같다.

items.title: 우리에게 발라드란 무엇인가
items.snippet: “제가 음악을 할 수 있게 응원해 주시고 챙겨주신 마음들 덕분에 요즘 사랑이라는 감정을 많이 느끼고 있었는데요. 이 곡에도 그런 표현이 있더라고요. ‘나의 사랑은 함께 숨 쉬는 자유’라는 가사를 좋아하는데 꼭 특별한 걸 해주지 않아도 함께 숨 쉬면서 같이 있어 주는 게 사랑이라고 생각해요.”

items.title: 집 밖으로 나온 김장, 이색 체험이 되다
items.snippet: #1. 경기도 수원에 사는 직장인 이모(46)씨는 올해 처음 집 근처 김장 수업을 예약했다. 이씨는 “외할머니가 돌아가시고 어머니도 허리가 좋지 않으셔서 집안에서 김장하는 일이 사라졌다”며 “그동안 사서 먹기만 했는데, 우리 가족이 먹을 김치 정도는 직접 담그고 싶어 수업을 신청했다”고 했다.

items.title: 불안한 실존은 占에 기대곤 했다
items.snippet: 1966년, 초등학교 1학년 여름방학 때의 일이다. 읍내에서 30리 떨어진 산골 마을에 아이스케이크 통을 실은 자전거가 나타났다. “아-이-스-께-끼-!” 소리가 들리자 아이들이 뛰쳐나갔다. 쌀이나 보리 등 농산물을 가져가면 ‘아이스께끼’로 바꿔줬다. 부모들이 논밭에 나가 있었기에 동네 ‘형아, 누나’들의 ‘절도’는 쉬웠다. 필자도 처마 밑에 말리던 마늘 한 통을 뽑아 들고 나갔다. 아까워서 조금씩 핥아먹은 것이 화근이었다. 두 살 위 둘째 누나에게 들켰다. 누나는 밭일에서 돌아온 어머니께 일러바쳤다. 어머니의 응징은 혹독했다. 당연히 저녁밥도 굶었다.

items.title: 이혼 소장만으론 부족해? 고소장까지 내는 요즘 부부들
items.snippet: 가정법원 판사로 일한 적이 있어서인지 이혼 사건을 자주 맡는 편이다. 이혼 상담을 하다 형사법 이야기를 하는 일이 늘었다. 배우자 명의 계좌에서 1년치 생활비를 미리 빼놓으면 절도가 되는지, 배우자 휴대폰에서 증거를 채집하면 처벌되는지 묻는다. 과거에는 간통죄 고소를 빼면 이혼 소송 중에 배우자를 형사고소하는 일이 드물었다. 배우자에게 폭행을 당한 경우조차 고소를 안 하는 경우가 훨씬 많았고 고소를 해도 경찰이 수사를 꺼렸다. 흥신소를 통해 미행하며 몰래 사진을 찍거나 모텔 문을 따고 들어가는 일을 두고도 범죄라는 인식이 희미했다.

items.title: 최고의 가을 정원
items.snippet: 가을 단풍이 한창이다. 우리나라 최고의 가을 정원으로 꼽히는 곳 중 하나가 창덕궁 후원(後苑)이다. 창덕궁 북쪽에 펼쳐져 창경궁과 맞닿아 있는 한국의 대표적인 궁중 정원으로, 비원(祕苑)으로 부르는 이들도 많다.

items.title: 정부 지정 ‘귀하신 몸’? 무주택자는 웁니다
items.snippet: “무주택자에게만 집을 보여주겠다는 주인이 많아요. 답답하네요.”

items.title: 실패에 관대하지 못한 사회엔 희망이 없다
items.snippet: 2008년 미국발 금융위기 당시 그 충격은 단순히 미국뿐 아니라 전 세계 다른 국가들에도 영향을 주었다. 그 국가들 중 하나가 미국과 특히 친밀한 관계에 있었던 영국이었다. 하지만 2008~2010년 미국에서 도산한 은행이 300개가 넘었던 반면, 영국에서 같은 시기 도산한 은행은 5개에 불과했다. 이 숫자만 보면 금융기관의 위험한 투자 행위를 방관했던 미국 정부와 비교해서 금융기관에 대한 감독과 규제를 게을리하지 않은 영국 정부의 정책이 옳았다고 생각하기 쉽다.

items.title: 김장하러 평창 갈까, 방어 맛보러 제주 갈까
items.snippet: 입동과 함께 겨울의 맛이 온다. 추울수록 맛이 드는 음식들이다.

items.title: AI 학습용 자료 제공을 겸해 쓰는 이야기
items.snippet: 얼마 전 AI(인공지능)를 열심히 공부하는 지인이 AI와 대화하며 재미 삼아 만든 ‘김황식 전 국무총리의 정치 철학과 리더십 연구’라는 제목의 파일을 보내왔습니다. 저의 공직 생활의 행적과 저술 등을 분석해 만든 것입니다. 제목은 과장됐지만, 그 내용은 정확한 사실 관계를 바탕으로 만든 재미있고, 그럴듯한 분석이었습니다. AI가 이렇게까지 해내는가를 실감하며 깜짝 놀랐습니다.

items.title: 낚시·탐조·천체 관측… ‘아재 취미’가 인기라는데
items.snippet: #1. 직장인 유모(34·강서구)씨는 요즘 주말마다 어복(魚福)을 기원한다. 그는 지난 9월 서해안 주꾸미 낚시를 다녀온 뒤 그 매력에 빠져 거의 매주 낚싯배를 타고 있다. ‘아저씨 취미’라는 시선에 망설임은 잠시, 막상 배에 올라보니 연령대가 다양했다. 유씨는 “고민 끝에 10만원짜리 낚싯대도 장만했다”며 “기다리는 시간이 지루할 줄 알았는데 오히려 그 시간을 즐기게 됐다”고 했다.

items.title: 백석과 국수
items.snippet: 누르스름한 표지에 그려진 시인의 아스라한 얼굴, 백석(白石)이었다. 어느 문예지를 정기 구독하면 책을 선물로 받을 수 있었는데 그때 내가 고른 게 백석 시 전집이었다. 한 편을 읽는 데 많은 공과 시간이 들었다. 낯선 평안북도 방언과 한자 탓에 사전과 옥편을 번갈아 찾아가며 발굴하듯 읽었다. 곧 절반도 못 읽고 책을 덮었다. 어려워서가 아니었다. 좋아서였다. 더 깊이 빠져들어 백석을 사랑하게 되면 나의 시를 쓰지 못할 것 같은 막연한 불안이 들었다.

items.title: 李대통령, “한-동티모르, 민주주의 열망 함께 나눠온 각별한 친구”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 6일 한국을 공식 방문한 조제 하무르 오르타 동티모르 대통령과 만나 “한국과 동티모르는 독립과 평화, 민주주의를 향한 열망을 함께 나눠온 각별한 친구”라고 환대했다.이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 오르타 대통령과 오찬을 겸한 확대 정상회담을 하고 “동티모르의 평화 유지와 재건을 위해 헌신했던 대한민국의 상록수군은 양국 간의 특별한 연대의 상징으로 기억되고 있다”며 이같이 말했다.이어 “양국은 어두운 역사를 극복하고 독립을 이뤄냈고, 어려움 속에서도 민주주의를 지켜왔다는 점에서 서로 많이 닮아있다”며 “최근 우리 국민은 민주주의가 위협받는 중대한 위기 속에서 평화롭고 질서 있는 방식의 빛의 혁명을 통해 헌정 질서를 지켜냈다. 동티모르 국민 역시 오랜 시련과 역경 속에서도 대화와 화해를 통해 평화와 민주주의의 길을 열어 왔다”고 했다...

items.title: Hybrid integration of a SESAM with a silicon nitride photonic integrated circuit
items.abstract: The realization of high-performance femtosecond lasers on photonic integrated circuits (PICs) requires robust, low-loss coupling between a saturable absorber and a photonic waveguide. In this work, we demonstrate the hybrid integration of a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror (SESAM) with a silicon nitride (SiN) PIC by micro-assembly. This micro-assembly strategy transfers the non-linear functionality of the absorber onto the PIC. We characterize the linear and non-linear performance of an unbonded SESAM and of a SESAM bonded to inverse-tapered SiN waveguides. At 1560~nm, the bonded device shows a waveguide-coupled modulation depth of 5.2\%, a maximum reflectivity of 37.2\%, and a saturation fluence of 47~\textmu J/cm$^2$. This work demonstrates that SESAMs can be integrated directly onto silicon nitride-based PIC platforms and provides a pathway towards fully integrated, self-starti...

items.title: Experimental demonstration of dual-polarization nonreciprocal thermal emission at moderate magnetic fields
items.abstract: Conventional thermal emitters obey Kirchhoff's law of thermal radiation, which requires emissivity and absorptivity to be equal at each wavelength, angle, and polarization. This in turn places a fundamental limit on a range of radiative energy technologies as well as heat transfer. This constraint can however be overcome using magneto-optic semiconductors, which break Lorentz reciprocity under an applied magnetic field. However, in most prior experimental demonstrations, nonreciprocity has been restricted to TM polarization, since the electric field of TE-polarized light is parallel to the applied magnetic field. items.title: Asymptotic-Preserving Tensor Neural Networks for 3D High-Field Kinetic Equations with Applications to Uncertainty Quantification
items.abstract: Kinetic equations in the high-field regime describe particle transport dominated by electric-field acceleration and collisional relaxation. These equations are widely used in simulations of plasmas and semiconductor devices. Typical models include the Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck (VPFP) and Boltzmann--Poisson systems. Their high dimensionality and multiscale nature pose two of the major challenges to accurate and efficient numerical solution. To address these challenges, we propose an asymptotic-preserving tensor neural network (APTNN) method. Specifically, to reduce high-dimensional computational costs and memory requirements, we adopt the canonical polyadic (CP) decomposition structure of TNNs to approximate their solutions. items.abstract: Dark-state coherence in driven three-level systems underlies electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) and stimulated Raman adiabatic passage (STIRAP). Their performance depends on the coupling topology: in a ladder ($Ξ$) scheme the coherence can bypass a lossy intermediate state, whereas in a $V$ scheme it is carried by two excited states that both decay. We develop a topology-resolved Lindblad framework for driven three-level excitonic manifolds at fixed center-of-mass momentum, in which a single exciton couples to phonons, the radiation field and a dilute exciton gas. The $Ξ$ and $V$ manifolds are selected from the exciton spectrum by systematically screening optical brightness, intra-excitonic dipole strength and state compactness, making the selection reproducible and transferable to other materials. items.title: Hall-Density Collapse as Direct Evidence for Percolative Conduction Onset in Monolayer MoS$_2$ Transistors
items.abstract: The origin of the apparent metal-insulator transition in two-dimensional electron systems remains debated. Using temperature-dependent transport and Hall measurements on industry-relevant MoS$_2$ monolayer FETs with amorphous HfO$_2$ dielectrics, we establish classical percolation as the underlying mechanism. We report two complementary signatures of disorder-driven conduction onset: a temperature-independent Hall-density collapse as a function of absolute gate voltage and a vanishing activation energy at a characteristic carrier density $n_{\mathrm{c}}$, identified as the percolation threshold. These findings identify dielectric-interface disorder, rather than channel quality alone, as the key parameter governing device turn-on. items.abstract: Near-Threshold Computing (NTC) offers a substan- tial energy savings, i.e., up to 10x, for digital circuits. However, due to Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) variations, low voltage operating digital processors face increased susceptibility to timing errors. This work equips conventional massive MIMO algorithms with computational error detection mechanisms, en- abling reliable operation down to near-threshold voltages. While conventional hardware based Timing Error Detection (TED) systems introduce substantial overhead, this work modifies MIMO algorithms to seamlessly integrate low overhead Algorithm Based Fault Tolerance (ABFT). items.title: Near-Quantum-Limited Readout for the Princeton Axion Search using a sub-GHz Kinetic Inductance Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
items.abstract: Parametric amplifiers are a workhorse for near-quantum-limited measurements above 1 GHz. However, amplifier development has been more limited below 1 GHz. We present a kinetic inductance traveling-wave parametric amplifier (KI-TWPA) operating over 300-700 MHz, with gain exceeding 30 dB and pump powers of a few hundred nanowatts. The system noise performance, as measured by a variable-temperature noise source, is 2.5-3.5 quanta. This device is a versatile new tool for precision measurements of sub-GHz signals, with applications including readout of semiconductor spin qubits, superconducting detector arrays, and searches for new physics beyond the Standard Model. In this study, we examine the photonic and electronic coupling between single ZnO nanowire lasers and TMDs. Using deterministic nanomanipulation, we first hybridized the same nanowire first with a WS$_2$ monolayer and then with a MoS$_2$ monolayer. Upon hybridization with bilayer, trilayer, and bulk MoS$_2$, lasing is fully suppressed. Finite-Difference Eigenmode simulations show that the TMD absorbs part of the evanescent field. items.title: A Design Rule for Passive Reconfigurable Microwave Devices
items.abstract: Every reconfigurable microwave device places a tuning element - a varactor, a diode, transistor, microelectromechanical or phase-change switch, a ferroelectric or liquid-crystal load - inside a fixed passive network. The network can make a small change of the element produce a large change of the response, and design practice often credits it with the device's tuning capability. This paper shows that a fixed, linear, passive network cannot add to that capability. Each tuning element carries a tuning budget, a dimensionless length computed from its own impedance trajectory, and a fixed passive network can transmit that budget or lose part of it, never enlarge it. items.title: Electrostatics of Chern junctions in a magnetic field
items.abstract: Electrostatic control is central to the operation of semiconductor junctions made from conventional materials. Here, we theoretically investigate the electrostatic properties of lateral junctions between two-dimensional (2D) Chern semiconductors in a perpendicular magnetic field. The spectral asymmetry of a Chern semiconductor acts as a magnetic-field-induced effective dopant density that is dependent on the Chern number. As a consequence, two regions with different Chern numbers acquire different chemical potentials at charge neutrality, leading to a built-in potential of topological origin across the junction. Using this built-in potential as a boundary condition, we solve the 2D Poisson equation to obtain the electric potential and charge density profiles, as well as the capacitance, of Chern semiconductor junctions. items.title: NN-Based FeFET Compact Modeling for SPICE Simulation
items.abstract: Prototyping and early-stage circuit evaluation for emerging transistor technologies require fast and accurate compact models for SPICE simulations. Standard physics-based compact models, such as BSIM, offer high fidelity but demand extensive domain expertise and time-consuming equation formulation for every new physical effect, significantly slowing technology development. Neural network (NN)-based models offer a scalable alternative approach, but they rely heavily on smooth numerical solver data with explicit high-order derivative information. However, measurement data suffers from complex noise patterns, making derivative extraction challenging and complicating NN-based transistor modeling. This work presents a derivative-free NN training framework employing spectral normalization to naturally smooth derivative behavior and filter measurement noise. items.title: Atomic-Scale Phonon Engineering for Enhanced Thermal Transport in Wafer-Scale-Bonded $β$-Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$/SiC Heterostructures
items.abstract: Bonding semiconductors to substrates with high thermal conductivity is a promising way to solve the heat-dissipation problem of materials that transport heat poorly, and it avoids the lattice-matching constraints of conventional epitaxy. However, the lattice mismatch remains, leaving the two materials with mismatched phonon states, while poor interface quality scatters phonons even more. Together, these effects block phonon transport across the bonded interface and make interfacial thermal resistance a critical bottleneck, calling for careful interface engineering. Here, $β$-Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$/SiC serves as a model system for a phonon-bridging strategy. A nanoscale crystalline Si interlayer is designed and fabricated by wafer bonding to bridge the mismatched phonon states of $β$-Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ and SiC. items.title: Time-resolved infrared spectroscopy with entangled photons and visible-light detection
items.abstract: Time-resolved infrared (TR-IR) spectroscopy reveals molecular structural changes and charge-carrier dynamics on their intrinsic timescales, in photosynthesis, catalysis and optoelectronic materials, but requires complex sources of ultrashort infrared pulses, cryogenically cooled detectors to overcome thermal background, and intense probes that can perturb the sample. Quantum infrared spectroscopy avoids these constraints: harnessing quantum interference between the generation processes of frequency-entangled photon pairs, it reads out the infrared response of a sample by detecting only the visible partner photon, for which efficient detectors exist. To date, it has been limited to steady-state measurements. Here we demonstrate its ultrafast, time-resolved form with a picosecond visible pump pulse and a silicon detector. items.title: Generative Modeling for Cascading Extremes via Autoregressive Transformers
items.abstract: Extreme events often occur sequentially, from earthquake-tsunami cascades to successive extreme losses in financial markets. We introduce an extremal token representation that encodes multivariate observations as a categorical sequence. A quiet token records the absence of threshold exceedances; otherwise, the token identifies the exceeding component with the largest marginal probability-scale score. The representation is invariant to componentwise strictly increasing transformations. It preserves the identity and temporal ordering of dominant exceedances but discards their magnitudes and the identities of nondominant simultaneous exceedances. A decoder-only transformer estimates the history-dependent next-token kernel on this representation, and recursive sampling generates future token sequences from the induced joint predictive law. items.title: DefectSkills: Guiding AI agents through first-principles calculations for point defects in semiconductors and insulators
items.abstract: First-principles defect calculations can now be performed autonomously by AI agents, enabled by established computational methods and open-source Python toolkits. However, reliable and repeatable defect calculations require clear scientific and technical guidance that helps agents resolve ambiguities and avoid errors in calculation setup, execution, postprocessing, and analysis. Here, we present DefectSkills, a set of structured prompts that provides human-in-the-loop guidance to AI agents performing first-principles calculations of point defects in semiconductors and insulators using the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP). items.title: Optical Ceiling on Polaron Mobility in Disordered Molecular Semiconductors: Lessons from Eumelanin
items.abstract: Polaron hopping in disordered molecular semiconductors such as eumelanin is set by energetic disorder $σ$ and reorganization energy $λ$. We show that the reduced polaron absorption band encodes this transport problem. Its value at zero energy fixes the mean hop rate, which bounds the mobility in any dimension. For Gaussian disorder and classical vibrations its centroid is $E_\mathrm{op}=λ+(1-c)σ^2/k_BT$, its variance obeys the Hush relation, and the bound is the Marcus rate at $λ\to E_\mathrm{op}$; a 1D lower bound vanishes at $k_BT^*=(1-c)σ^2/λ$, read from optics.

items.title: Generalized Lorentz Framework for Active Semiconductor Quantum Surface Plasmonics
items.abstract: Nanostructured semiconductors provide an actively tunable platform for light-matter interactions across a broad spectral range. As feature sizes shrink to the deep nanoscale (~10 nm scale), nonclassical carrier dynamics and surface plasmonic responses become prominent, creating substantial challenges for a rigorous and efficient theoretical treatment. Here we develop a generalized Lorentz framework for quantum surface plasmonics in nanostructured semiconductors with arbitrary energymomentum dispersion relations. The framework enables efficient quantitative treatment of carrier nonlocality, carrier surface accumulation and depletion, and nonlocal damping in three-dimensional semiconductor nanostructures, under electrical tuning and across a wide range of doping densities. items.title: A RISC-V Simulator for the Tenstorrent Tensix Architecture
items.abstract: RISC-V based AI accelerators have become popular and not only for AI and ML, but also as vehicles for exploring HPC workloads more generally. Tenstorrent are one example, and whilst they document their Tensix architecture in detail and develop their software stack openly, running code has historically required a physical card, and their recently released simulator targets hardware equivalence rather than introspection. In this paper we present Wolfpine, a community developed RISC-V simulator for the Tensix architecture, supporting both the Wormhole and Blackhole generations and integrating seamlessly with the TT-Metal software stack. Constructed entirely from publicly available documentation, open source software and measurements on physical hardware, Wolfpine is written in pure Python for readability and ease of modification. items.title: Effect of compensation on magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As
items.abstract: The real mechanism of ferromagnetism in III-V diluted magnetic semiconductors such as Ga$_{1-x}$Mn$_x$As is still debated. The experimental results point out the realization of appreciable ferromagnetism at filling of the impurity band close to one-half that can be expressed in terms of compensation degree. Based on our recent results on the existence of two competing mechanisms of pair indirect exchange (with ferro- and antiferro alignment of Mn $d$ shells), a theory of magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As is presented. The molecular-field-like equation is derived in which the effective exchange constant contains all necessary information about material, including the Mn content, the compensation degree, the crystal coordination, and the parameters of two competing pair exchange interactions. items.title: Wavefront engineering with atomic Huygens' surfaces made simple
items.abstract: Atomic arrays provide a cooperative platform for light-mediated interactions in nonlocal metasurfaces which can operate in the quantum regime without nanofabricated optical elements or intrinsic material absorption. We present a minimal atomic implementation to harness wavefront engineering and create a near-ideal intrinsic atomic Huygens' surface. A simple bilayer square lattice with a two-atom unit cell, not limited to small lattice spacings, provides near-unity reflectionless transmission and a full $2π$ phase control of transmitted light without the localized site-dependent level shifts of previous proposals. This simplification is achieved through nonlocal radiative excitations that provide the familiar electric-dipole response with even radiation parity as well as an odd-parity radiation channel whose leading multipolar interpretation combines magnetic-dipole and electric-quadrupol...

items.title: Analytically Calibrated Upper L-Statistics for High-Dimensional Mean Change-Point Testing
items.abstract: This paper develops upper L-statistic methods for testing and localizing a high-dimensional mean change. At each candidate split, the proposed statistics rank the squared studentized CUSUM values across coordinates and aggregate either a fixed number or a fixed proportion of the largest entries. This construction connects max-type and sum-type procedures and provides sensitivity to a wide range of sparsity regimes. We establish asymptotic null distributions under an independent-component representation allowing weak cross-sectional dependence. The limiting laws are Poisson tangent processes for fixed ranks and Gaussian-process or Gumbel laws for proportional ranks. To improve finite-sample performance, we develop analytic calibrations for marginal variance estimation, cross-sectional dependence, extreme clustering, and skewness, and establish their first-order validity. items.title: Bezier-GP: Bezier-Surface-Based Gaussian Process for Chips-on-Wafer Warpage Modeling
items.abstract: As the semiconductor industry transitions to the post-Moore paradigm, wafer warpage has become a critical quality issue in advanced packaging; particularly for 3D stacking and high-bandwidth memory manufacturing where die-level deformation can affect bonding quality, interconnect reliability, and yield. However, direct high-throughput measurement of individual chip warpage remains difficult in mass-production environments, while existing wafer-level metrology systems routinely provide dense 3D shape data at the wafer scale. This paper proposes a Bezier-surface-based Gaussian Process---known as Bezier-GP---for chips-on-wafer warpage modeling. items.title: Temperature-Independent Logarithmic Current Slope in Interdiffusion-Broadened Silicon pn Junction toward Low-Power Thermometry
items.abstract: With the development of cryogenic technologies such as quantum computing, there is an increasing need for low-power cryogenic thermometers that minimize self-heating. Here, we report an anomalous temperature-independent logarithmic current slope, $d(\ln J)/dV$, in heavily doped silicon p$^{+}$n$^{+}$ junctions with significant dopant interdiffusion and highlight the advantages of our device as a low-power, cryogenic thermometer. Electrical characterizations from 2 to 420 K reveal that, at low forward bias, $d(\ln J)/dV$ remains nearly constant, which yields a voltage-temperature responsivity that is nearly independent of bias current. The observed transport cannot be fully understood with conventional diffusion or direct band-to-band tunneling. Instead, the results suggest the contribution of trap-assisted tunneling. items.title: Polariton tweezers
items.abstract: The non-invasive, deterministic manipulation of charge carriers remains a fundamental challenge in solid-state quantum technologies. Here, we demonstrate the concept of dynamic polariton tweezers capable of trapping and transporting electrons across a two-dimensional electron system via the long-range electrostatic potential of dipolar (d-) exciton-polaritons. By driving a semiconductor microcavity with a specifically engineered, non-collinear three-beam optical pump with TE-polarization, we synthesize a macroscopic polariton lattice with hexagonal symmetry. The spatially periodic field of this d-polariton condensate acts as a reconfigurable trapping landscape for the electrons. items.title: Cage-enforced i-wave altermagnetism in boron-carbon clathrates
items.abstract: The spin splitting of an altermagnet arises from a rotation that relates its two magnetic sublattices. In known cases it is fixed by the crystal structure. Here we show that guest-host frameworks separate the two roles. In the boron-carbon clathrates $M$B$_3$C$_3$ the ordered cage removes the translation between the two guest sites and enforces cubic $i$-wave altermagnetism, with six symmetry-enforced nodal planes, for any magnetic guest in the compensated state; strain retunes the class to $d$- or $g$-wave. We demonstrate the platform with GdB$_3$C$_3$: its compensated antiferromagnetic ground state is a narrow-gap semiconductor with spin splitting of 0.19 eV at the conduction-band edge, and its weakly pinned Néel vector switches the helicity-resolved optical response on and off according to the magnetic point group. items.title: Current-Confined Formation of a Buried Ge/Si Free Surface for Defect Filtering
items.abstract: Lattice-mismatched heteroepitaxy is limited by misfit dislocations, threading defects, and residual strain generated at buried interfaces. Here, we show that current-confined electrochemistry transforms the Ge/Si heterointerface into a laterally continuous nanometric free surface while preserving the Ge epilayer. A low-doped Ge layer on a conductive p-type Si substrate redirects anodization current toward the misfit-dislocation-rich interface. Numerical modelling including charge-transfer kinetics shows that this confinement arises from hole-limited charge transfer and, together with electrochemical calibration, defines a process window that combines interfacial current confinement with controlled Si porosification. items.title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. VII. Step kinetics
items.abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate the kinetics of attachment of new segments of the crystalline lattice (pyramids) at steps on the nonmetal-terminated surface of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. These surfaces are wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e. GaN(000-1) surface, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e. GaP(-1-1-1) gallium arsenide, GaAs(-1-1-1) and gallium antimonide GaSb(-1-1-1) surfaces. Diffusion species are gallium adatoms at high coverage or gallium adatoms connected with nonmetal atom creating stable pyramids. These pyramids arrive at the steps, and cannot be attached be directly because the Ga adatom at the pyramid base cannot be attached directly. Therefore they are incorporated into the step by additional nonmetal atoms glue atoms arriving from the vapor or detached from other segments of the surface terraces.

items.title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. VI. Surface diffusion on a nonmetal-terminated surface
items.abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate surface diffusion of adsorbates on the nonmetal-terminated surface of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. These surfaces are wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e. GaN(000-1) surface, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e. GaP(-1-1-1) gallium arsenide, GaAs (-1-1-1) and gallium antimonide GaSb (-1-1-1) surfaces. The mixed coverage consists of Ga adatoms in the first layer with a nonmetal atom attached above them forming a triangular-based pyramid. The pyramidal structures are stable during surface jumps involving rotations around one of the basal Ga adatoms. Thus, the diffusion proceeds via rotation (pivot) of the pair of the other basal Ga adatoms around an immobile Ga adatom moving them into new, originally empty sites. items.title: Cross-Domain Joint-Embedding Pretraining For Heterogeneous Industrial Time Series
items.abstract: Industrial predictive maintenance and manufacturing tasks frequently contain abundant sensor measurements, but with limited labeled data. We investigate cross-domain self-supervised pretraining using joint-embedding predictive architecture for heterogeneous industrial time series (JEPA-HITS), which learns one encoder from various domains such as battery, semiconductor chemical mechanical planarization (CMP), computer numerical control (CNC) machining, and bearing while preserving dataset-specific temporal scales. We evaluate representation reuse on regression and classification problems under reduced-label downstream training, and leave-one-domain-out (LODO) pretraining. items.title: Gate-tunable superconductor-semiconductor coupling and its impact on zero-energy modes in PbTe-Pb nanowires
items.abstract: Superconductor-semiconductor coupling in hybrid nanowires plays a pivotal role in Majorana devices. Here, we demonstrate this tunable coupling in PbTe-Pb nanowires and its impact on the induced gap and zero-bias peaks (ZBPs). In the strong coupling regime, the device reveals a clean superconducting gap, where robust and non-robust ZBPs are observed in distinct magnetic field ranges. Conversely, increasing the gate voltage drives the system toward the weak coupling regime, where the gap becomes narrow and soft. Consequently, robust ZBPs disappear while non-robust ones persist. Our results establish a direct link between tunable coupling and robust ZBPs, providing guidelines on engineering Majorana zero modes and topological qubits.

items.title: Amplification of valley polarization in an hBN-separated MoSe2-WSe2 heterostructure
items.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures host long-lived interlayer excitons in the +K and -K valleys that can encode long-lived valley polarization. We investigated the low-temperature valley polarization dynamics in an MoSe2-bilayer hBN-WSe2 heterostructure. The bilayer hBN spacer results in an interlayer exciton lifetime exceeding 2 μs and an anomalous valley polarization amplification effect. Our theoretical model shows that this amplification results from the long exciton lifetime and exciton-exciton interactions. This work sets the stage for long-lived interlayer excitons to be used in nonlinear valleytronic transistors and amplifiers.

items.title: Optical Detection of Coefficient of Thermal Expansion via Frequency Tracking at Cryogenic Temperatures
items.abstract: Accurate characterization of the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) in nanoscale thin films is critical for predicting residual stress and ensuring the reliability of modern micro-electromechanical systems and advanced semiconductor architectures. The primary limitation is that traditional methods depend on precise thickness measurements or are restricted to crystalline materials. In this work, we present an in-situ, non-destructive optical methodology to determine the CTE of suspended nanofilms by tracking the temperature-dependence of their vibrational frequency. This approach eliminates thickness measurements entirely and works for amorphous films where X-ray diffraction (XRD) fails. items.abstract: The electronic properties of semiconductor heterostructures are influenced by the local bonding and electrostatic environment at the heterointerface. items.title: Nondestructive 3D Metrology of Through-Glass Via Geometry and Internal Wall Texture Using Holotomography
items.abstract: Through-glass vias (TGVs) are increasingly important for semiconductor packaging, yet their internal geometry and wall texture remain difficult to characterize nondestructively. Here, we use holotomography (HT) to inspect the three-dimensional (3D) geometry and internal wall texture of intact, unfilled TGVs before metallization. HT reconstructs the refractive index (RI) distribution of the glass and via. Maps of RI and spatially filtered RI then localize the internal boundary. Geometric fitting quantifies via dimensions and taper, while spatial filtering separates slowly varying wall form from finer texture. items.title: Trapping photo-carriers in undoped gate-defined quantum dots using an on-chip microwave resonator for charge readout
items.abstract: Scaling up gate-defined quantum dot systems is hindered by the rapid growth in the number of control gates. To tackle this challenge, we propose a different approach where the quantum dots are created from optically generated charges trapped beneath accumulation gates. By shining an above-the-gap laser light onto an undoped GaAs substrate, we demonstrate that it is possible to create and separate electron-hole pairs to form quantum dots. For the charge readout, we use a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator capacitively coupled to the quantum dots. With these elements, we demonstrate a working many-charge double quantum dot device comprised of only two plunger gates, one tunnel coupling gate and one sensing gate. items.title: Energy Transfer and Strong Coupling in Plasmonic Systems
items.abstract: The coupling between plasmon resonances of metal nanostructures and electronic excitations of molecular/semiconductor systems is important in a number of applications, including surface enhanced spectroscopy, hot-electron catalysis, plasmon-induced resonance energy transfer and the creation of hybrid light-matter states. The past several decades has seen a large number of experimental studies of these effects, as well as the development of theory to explain the results. In this Perspectives article we use classical electromagnetic (EM) simulations to examine how the localized surface plasmon resonances (LSPRs) of metal nanoparticles and propagating surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs) in extended metal nanostructures (wires/plates/films) are affected by interactions with a molecular/semiconductor system. The classical EM simulations are complemented by a quantum model for plasmon-exciton co...

items.title: Cross-Scale Spatial Reasoning: A Learning-Centered Framework for Designing Immersive Learning Environments
items.abstract: Understanding complex scientific and engineering systems often requires learners to connect structures, processes, and behaviors across different spatial scales and levels of organization. Although research on spatial cognition, scale, multiple representations, and systems thinking has examined aspects of this challenge, these perspectives do not always provide explicit guidance for designing learning activities that require learners to integrate information across levels. Immersive technologies offer opportunities to explore otherwise inaccessible structures, coordinate representations, and investigate system behavior, but their educational value depends on the reasoning they support. This paper proposes Cross-Scale Spatial Reasoning (CSSR) as an integrative framework for understanding how learners establish and use spatial and structural relationships across scales or organizational le...

items.title: Reasoning Across Scales: Learning Challenges and Opportunities for Immersive Technologies in Chip Design Education
items.abstract: As demand for semiconductor talent grows, education must prepare learners for the complexity of modern chip design. Instruction typically relies on lectures, textbooks, software exercises, and limited laboratory experiences. Although foundational, these approaches offer limited support for understanding the spatial, multi-scale, and interconnected nature of chip design. Virtual reality (VR) can help learners visualize and interact with complex structures and processes, but its educational opportunities remain underexplored. We examined this gap through chip design curriculum analysis and semi-structured interviews with five participants representing instructional and learner perspectives. We characterized four learning demands: descriptive knowledge, procedural knowledge, relational and design-focused reasoning, and strategic decision-making. We identified challenges in connecting abstra...

items.title: Visualizing Anisotropic Charge Transport in CrSBr using Bias-Dependent Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
items.abstract: Anisotropic semiconductors offer unique opportunities for next-generation electronics due to their direction-dependent transport. However, conventional electrical measurements provide only spatially averaged characteristics. Here, we employ bias-dependent Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) to directly visualize the response of CrSBr under different electrical bias configurations. Spatially resolved KPFM maps reveal highly distinct, crystallographic-direction-dependent potential profiles. To elucidate this behavior, we employ anisotropic transport simulations that capture the charge transport and electric-field distributions in CrSBr. The close agreement between experiment and simulation provides a unified picture of anisotropic charge transport and bias-induced potential redistribution. Our experiments further reveal a boundary-associated redistribution of the transport field when bias...

A decade later, that number had increased fivefold. In 1901, the companies produced 7,000 vehicles. By 1910, production had reached 181,000. items.title: Streaming Virtual Metrology via Lightweight Adaptation under Temporal Distribution Shifts
items.abstract: Virtual metrology (VM) aims to estimate costly or delayed metrology variables from heterogeneous sensor signals and in-line measurements, and it acts as a critical component of semiconductor manufacturing. While recent data-driven models have improved VM accuracy, most are trained in batch settings and assume stationary data distributions. In practice, however, production environments evolve continuously due to equipment degradation, process adjustments, and maintenance events, making conventional batch-trained VM models difficult to maintain under temporal distribution shifts. In this work, we propose GRAPE (Global Regression with Adaptive Prediction Enhancement), a practical online learning framework for VM in evolving wafer-processing environments. GRAPE integrates a stable global predictor based on interpretable representations with two lightweight streaming adapters that correct fea...

items.title: A Mixed-Precision CNN-LSTM Accelerator Featuring Long-Kernel Memory Reuse and Dynamic Quantization for Sleep Staging
items.abstract: This letter presents a mixed-precision CNN-LSTM accelerator for EEG-based sleep staging. To efficiently execute long temporal convolutions, a serpentine dataflow propagates activations between neighboring processing elements, reducing memory accesses by 6.2 times and 2.25 times compared with output- and weight-stationary dataflows, respectively. A hybrid quantization scheme applies runtime dynamic quantization to the LSTM and MLP layers and assigns mixed precision on a layer-by-layer basis, reducing model size by 4.16 times. Combined with a bit-flexible MAC architecture and channel-grouped memory scheduling, the accelerator supports INT2/4/8/16 inference. Fabricated in 65 nm CMOS, the accelerator consumes 0.40 mW and achieves a 258 times speedup over an iso-frequency 32b RISC-V processor. Evaluated across all 62 subjects in the public MASS-SS3 dataset using 31-fold leave-two-subject-out...

items.title: Effect of Rapid Thermal Annealing on the Superconductivity of ALD-Grown TiN thin films
items.abstract: Titanium nitride (TiN) is a promising superconducting material for scalable quantum technologies owing to its tunable kinetic inductance and compatibility with CMOS thin-film processing. However, the superconducting performance of atomic-layer-deposited TiN can be degraded by oxygen incorporation, off-stoichiometry, and crystallographic disorder. In this work, we investigate rapid thermal annealing (RTA) in high-purity nitrogen as a post-deposition strategy to improve polycrystalline TiN films grown by RF-biased plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition. Grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction reveals reduced peak broadening, a smaller lattice parameter, and a stronger (111) preferred orientation with increasing annealing temperature. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy depth profiling shows reduced oxygen-related bonding and a shift toward a Ti--N-dominated chemical environment after annealing....

items.title: Route-Aware EM Surrogate for Automated LC Matching Network Optimization
items.abstract: This paper proposes an open-source automated LC matching network optimization framework that combines schematic-level design optimization with electromagnetic (EM)-aware post-layout refinement. An ML-based surrogate predicts the frequency-dependent complex admittance of individual routes, enabling reuse across matching network topologies and physical layouts for the same technology node without retraining. These route models guide post-layout passive retuning to recover matching performance while preserving the layout footprint. Evaluated in a commercial 65nm CMOS technology, the surrogate achieves 1.94-4.91% mean absolute percentage error with respect to a full-wave electromagnetic solver, with no detected passivity violations. Vibrations observed during the SuperCDMS Soudan experiment generated broadband low-frequency noise (LFN), which due to its similarity in the pulse shape to the low-energy signal events is difficult to remove. In the final low ionization threshold analysis, CDMSlite Run 3, the strong event selection criterion applied to remove LFN events also significantly reduced the ability to identify signal events in the low energy region, thus reducing the sensitivity of the experiment to low-mass dark matter. Therefore, an LFN rejection criterion using machine learning (ML) aimed to improve the signal efficiency while maintaining the signal purity has now been developed. items.title: Field-resolved observation and quantification of the instantaneous Kerr response in semiconductors
items.abstract: The optical Kerr effect, whereby the refractive index of a material changes with light intensity, underpins nonlinear photonics and emerging mid-infrared technologies. Accurate determination of the nonlinear refractive index is therefore essential, yet conventional intensity-based techniques infer the nonlinear phase shift indirectly from changes in beam propagation or optical spectra. Moreover, methods such as the $z$-scan cannot resolve the temporal evolution of the nonlinear response, making it difficult to distinguish instantaneous Kerr nonlinearities from delayed contributions, including free-carrier effects. Here, we investigate the nonlinear optical response of germanium at $5 μ\mathrm{m}$ using field-resolved degenerate pump-probe spectroscopy. items.abstract: Scaling silicon spin qubits to fault-tolerant processors requires semiconductor foundry integration, yet it remains unclear how industrial fabrication and dense device integration affect qubit control and noise. Here we study ${}^{28}\mathrm{Si}/\mathrm{SiGe}$ electron spin-1/2 qubits fabricated using Intel's industry-compatible 300 mm process and incorporating micromagnets for electrically driven spin resonance, using a high-performance device fabricated in the RIKEN research cleanroom as a reference. Primitive $π/2$-gate fidelities reach the 99.99% level in the Intel devices, which also exhibit longer idle coherence, weaker low-frequency correlations and reduced qubit-to-qubit variability across several measured characteristics. items.title: Full-Potential Korringa Kohn Rostoker Study of Structural and Mechanical Properties in SiGeSn Alloys
items.abstract: Accurate first-principles descriptions of open, covalently bonded crystal structures remain challenging within conventional Korringa--Kohn--Rostoker (KKR) approaches owing to the spherical approximations commonly employed for the effective crystal potential. Here, we systematically assess the recently developed full-potential KKR (KKR-FP) implementation in the open-source MuST package and demonstrate its applicability to diamond-structured group-IV semiconductors and SiGeSn alloys. Benchmark calculations for diamond-structured Si reveal substantial limitations of the conventional muffin-tin and atomic sphere approximations, whereas KKR-FP accurately reproduces the experimental equilibrium lattice parameter and bulk modulus, yielding 5.433 and 94.9 GPa. The full-potential treatment also recovers the semiconducting character of Si. Further calculations for elemental Ge and Sn establish the...

items.title: Dipolar Exciton Polarons in a van der Waals Homobilayer
items.abstract: Fermi polarons exemplify how many-body interactions give rise to emergent quasiparticles, providing a fundamental framework for understanding interacting quantum matter. In electron-doped two-dimensional semiconductors, exciton polarons offer optical access to Fermi-polaron physics and electrical tunability, yet achieving stronger and more controllable exciton-electron interactions remains a key challenge. Here, we realize dipolar exciton polarons in an electrically tunable van der Waals homobilayer, where interlayer excitons with spatially separated electrons and holes act as quantum impurities carrying permanent electric dipole moments. These dipolar polarons exhibit substantially enhanced exciton-electron interactions, with binding energies more than four times those of conventional intralayer exciton polarons. We further demonstrate that Fermi-sea layer polarization provides an addit...

items.title: Photonic Crystal Integrated Graphene-Silicon Schottky Diodes for Resonant Infrared Photodetection
items.abstract: Narrowband infrared (IR) photodetection has become a critical technology for the next generation of smart low-power photodetectors. In this work, we present a device based on a graphene-silicon Schottky junction with narrowband response in the short-wave IR (SWIR) regime. Integrating a photonic crystal (PhC) slab in the device enables a wavelength dependant tailoring of graphene absorption. The devices were characterized by photocurrent measurement, which was enhanced more than two orders of magnitude by the PhC integration. The sharp enhancements obtained can also be predicted by numerical simulation. This approach offers a highly scalable, tunable, CMOS-compatible architecture for narrowband IR photodetection, paving the way for next-generation, low-power IR sensors.

In this contribution, we evaluated ILGAD sensors bump-bonded to 25 μm pitch charge-integrating MÖNCH chips at a laser-driven soft X-ray source. items.abstract: We present a comprehensive density functional theory (DFT) investigation of the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, thermoelectric, and bonding properties of Y2CdX4 (X = S, Se, Te) compounds for potential optoelectronic and energy-conversion applications. Structural optimization reveals a systematic expansion of the equilibrium lattice parameters from S to Te. The calculated bulk moduli decrease from 83 GPa for Y2CdS4 to 68 GPa for Y2CdSe4 and 54 GPa for Y2CdTe4, indicating progressive lattice softening. Electronic band-structure calculations predict indirect band gaps of 2.42, 2.08, and 1.71 eV for Y2CdS4, Y2CdSe4, and Y2CdTe4, respectively, with further narrowing upon inclusion of spin-orbit coupling. The considered adsorbates are nonmetal species, i.e., nitrogen, phosphorus, arsenic, and antimony on wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e., GaN(0001) surfaces, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e., GaP(111), gallium arsenide, GaAs(111), and gallium antimonide, GaSb (111) surfaces. The cases investigated include single adsorbed nonmetal atoms and full coverage, i.e. theta=1 of these surfaces. The calculated results include the stable sites and the energies of the single adsorbed atoms: located at H3 sites at low coverage and in on-top positions at high coverage for GaP, GaAs and GaSb. items.abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to elucidate the properties of the polar surfaces of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors, i.e., metal- and nonmetal-terminated. The systems considered were clean wurtzite gallium nitride (i.e. (0001) and (000-1) GaN surfaces), zinc blende gallium phosphide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaP), gallium arsenide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaAs), and (111) and (-1-1-1) GaSb surfaces. items.abstract: Colloidal semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are highly promising materials for various applications, yet photoluminescence intermittency (blinking) remains a key obstacle to their practical use. While recent advances have enabled partial or complete suppression of this effect, both the degree of suppression and the mechanism by which it occurs are often difficult to establish. In the present work we analyse the blinking suppression of single CdSe/ZnS QDs after treatment with p-phenylenediamine (PPD), recently discovered by Yang et al. We revisit the blinking mechanism in this system and show that it is governed predominantly by the trapping mechanism, rather than by Auger ionization as previously proposed. items.title: FrontierMat: Benchmarking Language Models at the Frontier of Materials R&D
items.abstract: To accelerate materials discovery, language models must be able to address problems at the research frontier. Yet textbook- and examination-derived benchmarks primarily assess established knowledge, leaving performance on frontier research problems largely untested. We introduce FrontierMat, a benchmark of 330 problems drawn from frontier academic and industrial research in fields including aerospace, semiconductors, embodied intelligence and nuclear fusion. Every problem is validated by leading experimentalists and industry experts in its field. Each problem presents a real study and asks the model to infer a withheld outcome or draw a conclusion from selected experimental evidence. Problems are annotated by functional domain, material system and the scale of the governing mechanism; 130 require cross-scale reasoning. The strongest general-purpose model scores only 53.7%, and on matched...

items.title: Unifying dynamical electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions from first principles
items.abstract: Electron-phonon interactions in materials with free carriers are dynamically screened by low-energy electronic excitations, yet first-principles calculations almost always treat this screening in the adiabatic approximation. A fully dynamical treatment of metals and doped semiconductors within time-dependent density functional perturbation theory (TDDFPT) is expensive and numerically delicate. Here, we introduce DFPT+A downfolding ("A" for active space), which starts from the static density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) response of a computationally convenient base system and adds the dynamical screening of a low-energy active space, described by Wannier functions. items.title: Evaluating Structural and SAT Attack Resilience in Cryptographic Dynamic Logic Locking via Keystream Capping
items.abstract: Untrusted third-party entities throughout the semiconductor supply chain expose proprietary hardware intellectual property to reverse engineering, piracy, and overproduction. While logic locking counters this threat by embedding key-dependent logic, conventional static key-gates remain vulnerable to both oracle-guided SAT attacks and structural removal attacks due to their time-invariant netlist signatures. Dynamic schemes such as STREAMLOCK mitigate oracle attacks by continuously masking signals with cryptographic keystream, achieving near 50\% Hamming distance output corruption under incorrect keys with low hardware overhead. However, confining key-gates to primary outputs leaves internal combinational cones vulnerable to single-tap structural bypasses. items.title: Complete Au-free Metallization Platform for UWBG Al$_{0.65}$Ga$_{0.35}$N channel MOS-HEMTs using Ti/Al/Ti Ohmic Contacts and Refractory TiN/Pt Gates
items.abstract: Au-free ohmic contacts and refractory gate stacks are critical for integrating ultra-wide-bandgap (UWBG) Al-rich AlGaN transistors with Si-CMOS technology. In this work, we demonstrate, to our knowledge, the first complete Au-free metallization platform for Al$_{0.65}$Ga$_{0.35}$N-channel MOS-HEMTs, combining electron-beam-evaporated and sputtered Ti/Al/Ti ohmic contacts with sputtered TiN and Pt gate metals. The Ti/Al/Ti contacts achieved a contact resistance of approximately 7.5--7.7 $Ω\cdot$mm while being fully Au-free. This contact resistance is achieved using a 600 $^\circ$C anneal, substantially below the 850--950 $^\circ$C typically required for Au-capped Ti/Al/X/Au contacts on Al-rich AlGaN, indicating a reduced thermal budget and improved compatibility with silicon-CMOS foundries. items.title: Efficient Simulation of Gate Leakage Currents in Ultra-scaled Transistors from First Principles
items.abstract: To ensure high electrostatic integrity in ultra-scaled field-effect transistors (FETs), thin gate dielectric layers are typically needed, potentially giving rise to (strong) leakage currents. Being able to model this effect is therefore crucial. Here, we show how gate leakage currents can be computed at the ab initio level in WS$_2$-hBN FETs by extending the well-established quantum transmitting boundary method (QTBM). Two main challenges are tackled: (i) the calculation of the open boundary conditions (OBCs) for the gate contacts and (ii) the solution of the resulting sparse linear system of equations A x = b where the matrix A possesses an unstructured sparsity pattern. We demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state of the art and can be readily applied to simulate transistors with gate lengths exceeding 25 nm.

Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production. items.abstract: Alloying offers a convenient route to tune the physical properties of semiconductors, at the price, however, of local lattice/bond distortions needed to accommodate the lattice mismatch. Being nearly lattice-matched and moreover highly resistant to lattice and bond distortions thanks to a largely covalent bonding, cubic Zn(1-x)Mn(x)Te sets a benchmark to test the sensitivity of lattice vibrations to minimum lattice and bond distortions induced by alloying. items.title: Electronic liquid crystals and superconductivity from doping a moiré Mott insulator
items.abstract: Electronic liquid crystals, such as stripe phases and nematics, are self-organized states of matter with spontaneously broken rotational symmetry. They are expected to emerge in a doped Mott insulator as a compromise between short- and long-range Coulomb interactions, and are believed to be intimately connected to the emergence of high temperature superconductivity either as a competing order or an intertwined order. Moiré semiconductors provide a controllable platform to explore the relationship between stripe phases and superconductivity near a Mott insulator. Here we report the generic appearance of stripe phases in a doped moiré Mott insulator and the observation of a stripe to-superconductor quantum phase transition in twisted bilayer WSe2. Phase purity in terms of n is crucial towards narrow emission bands and the design of band structure alignment for charge carrier funneling. We present a simple and scalable synthesis method using cesium and butylammonium as A-cations to fabricate microcrystal powders of 2D lead bromide perovskites that results in samples with very high n-phase purity. The obtained microcrystals show a sharp onset in absorbance and single narrow emission peak in UV-blue spectral range, and we confirm their structure and composition with X-ray diffraction and energy dispersive spectroscopy. items.abstract: Constructing accurate and physically interpretable tight binding (TB) Hamiltonians from first principles calculations remains challenging, particularly for materials exhibiting complex orbital hybridization, spin orbit coupling (SOC), and magnetic order. The framework supports s to f orbitals, incorporates on site SOC and site resolved magnetic exchange interactions, and accommodates both orthogonal and nonorthogonal basis. items.title: PDE-based Bayesian Inverse Problems in All-at-once Framework
items.abstract: We propose a modern all-at-once framework for PDE-based Bayesian inversion by introducing the PDE residual as probabilistic information. In this framework, the PDE residual is treated as a soft constraint with a residual covariance and is directly incorporated into the likelihood function. The new hybrid likelihood function eliminates PDE solves, thus reducing expensive computational costs, while performing rigorous Bayesian inference. Theoretically, we establish the well-posedness of the posterior with uncertainty quantification, and numerically, we propose two efficiency inversion algorithms based on two posterior sampling methods. items.abstract: This paper presents the circuit-level implementation of a mismatch-tolerant high-gain operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) using automatic negative-conductance calibration in 65-nm CMOS. The implementation addresses practical challenges involving comparator offset, DAC design, and subtractor gain and offset. items.title: Characterizing Performance Tradeoffs in Heterogeneous GPU-Wafer-Scale Accelerator Systems
items.abstract: As AI accelerator architectures become increasingly diverse, integrating different architectures into a unified system is emerging as a new heterogeneous computing paradigm. GPUs and WSEs differ substantially in compute, memory, and communication organization, creating both architectural complementarity and additional overheads, yet how to translate this heterogeneity into practical performance gains remains unclear. To address this gap, we propose a hierarchical benchmarking methodology to characterize GPU--WSE heterogeneous execution and the conditions for exploiting complementarity, together with an analytical performance model that identifies when heterogeneity becomes a bottleneck and when it yields system-level performance gains.

items.title: Online Open-World Wafer Defect Discovery using Hyperdimensional Computing
items.abstract: Conventional wafer defect analysis relies on offline, closed-world classifiers that fail to detect novel, unseen defect signatures emerging during continuous semiconductor manufacturing. To address this, we propose WaferHDC, an online open-world wafer defect discovery framework based on hyperdimensional computing (HDC). The memory-centric architecture of WaferHDC enables rapid anomaly detection and grouping of recurring failures into compact hypervector representations. This allows the memory space to dynamically scale with new defect modes without retraining a static classifier or archiving entire raw wafer history. WaferHDC first models normal spatial distributions, then dynamically groups recurring failures into persistent defect memory without labels or predefined class counts. It outperforms the strongest online baseline by 13.3 p.p. in adjusted Rand index and 10.5 p.p. in normalize...

items.title: Residual AM and PM Noise of Selected X-Band Amplifiers
items.abstract: In microwave systems design, amplitude modulation (AM) noise is often ignored relative to phase modulation (PM) noise. However, in high-performance applications requiring ultra-low PM noise, AM noise becomes a critical limiting factor due to AM-to-PM conversion mechanisms. Because AM noise specifications are rarely, if ever, provided for commercial microwave components, this study characterizes the residual AM and PM noise of several 10 GHz amplifiers. We present performance data for various Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor (HBT) amplifier designs and demonstrate the noise reduction achieved through power-summed configurations. For example, a discrete-die GaAs HBT amplifier achieves residual PM noise below $-160$ dBrad$^2$/Hz and AM noise of approximately $-155$ dB/Hz at a 1 kHz offset in a quad power-summed configuration. items.title: Hierarchical Fourier Phase Projection for Local Electronic Observables
items.abstract: In this letter, we develop hierarchical Fourier phase projection (HPP) for the calculation of local electronic observables. The method couples the spatial decay of the density matrix with a hierarchy of Fourier probes, improving accuracy through refinement, and making use of all previously evaluated responses. The variation in the calculated observables during the refinement process carries information on the residual error. We use a locality-based model to estimate the error from these changes with no extra probing calculations. In particular, we demonstrate the method for electron densities and nonlocal pseudopotential forces for fixed Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians of semiconductors, metals and thermally perturbed silica. The convergence is significantly accelerated by the spatial decay of the density matrix, especially if the density matrix is short-ranged. The number of probes necessary to...

items.title: Laser-Induced Rashba Spin-Orbit Torques in Multiferroic Semiconductor (Ge,Mn)Te
items.abstract: The multiferroic semiconductor (Ge,Mn)Te exhibits ferroelectricity, strong Rashba spin-orbit coupling, and carrier-mediated magnetic order, making it a unique platform for exploring the interplay between electronic, structural, and magnetic degrees of freedom. In this study, we investigate the ultrafast magnetization dynamics of Ge0.85Mn0.15Te using time-resolved magneto-optical spectroscopy. By separating magnetic and nonmagnetic contributions in the transient response, we identify two distinct laser-induced magnetic phenomena, both arising from a photoinduced effective spin-orbit torque. Coherent magnetization precession is driven by a laser-induced increase in hole concentration, which modifies the occupation of Rashba split, spin-locked valence band states and shifts the position of the magnetic easy axis. items.title: Uncertainty and Business-Aware Remaining Useful Life Estimation for Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.abstract: Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimates guide maintenance in semiconductor manufacturing, where a late intervention can disrupt production but an early one discards usable equipment life. A single prediction does not express the uncertainty needed to choose between these outcomes. We combine Deep Learning (DL) sequence models with Simoultaneous Quantile Regression (SQR) to estimate RUL at selectable quantile levels, and evaluate maintenance decisions using Unexpected Breaks (UB), Unexploited Lifetime (UL), and a cost-weighted objective. On the $F_1$ fault mode of the 2018 PHM Data Challenge (PHM18) ion-milling dataset, we compare recurrent, Transformer, and State Space Models (SSM) architectures. Diagonal State Spaced (S4D) gives the strongest overall RUL accuracy across the evaluated quantiles. Varying the quantile and maintenance window exposes the trade-off between failure risk and earl...

items.title: Transport-Noise and Optical Witnesses of Electronic Multipartite Entanglement
items.abstract: Entanglement among particles distinguishes correlated quantum materials from conventional metals and semiconductors. Experimentally certifying intrinsic entanglement among interacting electrons in materials is important not only for classifying states of matter, but also for developing material-based quantum technologies. Here, we introduce a transport protocol for witnessing multipartite entanglement from the equilibrium current-noise spectrum, measured directly or reconstructed from optical conductivity. The appropriately integrated, symmetrized, and projected noise spectrum obeys an upper bound derived from microscopic model parameters. Unlike witnesses based on localized spins, our framework applies to general electronic states without requiring magnetic moments and remains invariant under single-particle basis transformations. items.title: DACRI: Decision-Aware Causal Intervention Ranking for Critical Supply Chains
items.abstract: Detecting or attributing a supply-chain disruption is not the same as selecting the intervention that maximizes recoverable net value. We present CriticalSCM-Bench v1, a controlled synthetic benchmark with causal ground truth, paired factual/counterfactual rollouts, and an explicit net-value objective. Relative to a full-information train-selected static benchmark, LambdaMART improves median normalized net value by 5.7--16.2\%, with paired statistical support on the semiconductor and critical-material archetypes but not on digital infrastructure. On digital infrastructure, a domain-informed constant-buffer policy remains stronger, showing that greater model complexity is not uniformly justified. Across partial and delayed settings, LambdaMART retains 33--75\% of full-clamp value. Stress tests further show that intervention fidelity, timing, cost, and held-out disruptions can alter policy...

items.title: Fluctuation electrodynamics of quantum capacitance in electron bilayers
items.abstract: Capacitance provides a thermodynamic probe of interacting electrons. It characterizes the energy cost of transferring charge between conductors, which, in low-dimensional systems, is governed by exchange and correlation effects in addition to electrostatic contributions. We develop a theory of the quantum capacitance of electron double layers, semiconductor quantum wells as well as monolayer and bilayer graphene devices, focusing on the contribution generated by interlayer correlations. Within a functional-integral formulation we show that the separation-dependent part of the ground-state energy is, at the level of ring diagrams, exactly the nonretarded Lifshitz expression for the van der Waals energy of two conducting sheets, with reflection amplitudes built from the layer polarizabilities. items.title: Who Needs DRAM? We Have Fiber
items.abstract: The rising pressure on DRAM availability and contract pricing reflects generative AI's massive high-performance memory requirements. This pressure is heavily compounded by hyperscale data center expansion, which now consumes a significant portion of global DRAM output. In this work, we propose a new architecture, Fiber Memory, which reimagines the role of optical fiber in a hyperscale data center, deploying it as an active, recirculating delay-line memory for immutable data, such as large language model weights. We present a hybrid data- and pipeline-parallel optical broadcast delay-line memory architecture that accounts for fiber's physical realities. items.title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
items.abstract: Gold nanonecklace networks exhibit non-Ohmic current--voltage I-V characteristics with a sharp conduction threshold, making them promising for sensing and transistor-like devices. However, their conduction has been understood largely empirically, because experiments cannot see how conduction evolves inside the network. To address this, we develop a graph-based Kirchhoff modeling framework that resolves these internal processes, tracking the potential and current of every junction. Although every active element conducts linearly, the model reproduces the non-Ohmic response $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$. It also captures the experimentally observed effects of junction properties, network density, and voids, which lends confidence to its predicted internal states. items.title: Controllable Quantum Spin Hall Phases in Bi$_2$Te$_3$-Family van der Waals Heterobilayers
items.abstract: The tunability and control of topological edge/surface states are crucial for the development of new device applications. In this work, by combining first-principles calculations and Wannier-based tight-binding methods, we show the emergence of quantum spin Hall phases in van der Waals heterostructures formed by stacking two trivial quintuple layers from the Bi$_2$Te$_3$ family. We demonstrate the tunability of the edge states under interlayer strain and external electric field effects, suggesting the possibility of switching topological edge states on/off by external control. Additionally, the quantum spin Hall edge channels remain robust against interlayer twist, highlighting their stability against external perturbations. Our results provide a new way to create and manipulate two-dimensional topological phases in systems based on Bi$_2$Te$_3$ family, which can be valuable for practica...

items.title: Coexistence of Donor and Acceptor Hydrogen States in n-Type InN
items.abstract: Hydrogen often exhibits amphoteric behavior in semiconductors, but its role is in n-type InN remains unresolved. Wurtzite InN is a narrow-gap semiconductor with high electron mobility and is therefore attractive for high-speed electronics and optoelectronic applications. Here we use hard x-ray photoemission spectroscopy (HAXPES) to probe hydrogen-related electronic structure in as-grown and post-annealed InN thin films prepared at different grown temperatures. Post annealing, which reduces the concentration of hydrogen impurities in the films, shifts the core-level spectra toward lower binding energy, consistent with a chemical-potential shift associated with the passivation of electron carriers.
